        function stripeResponseHandler(status, response) {
      var $form = $('#trial_plans');



          //scroll to error / please wait
          $("html, body").scrollTop(0);

          if (response.error) {



              // Show the errors on the form
              $form.find('.fail_message').show();
              $form.find('.payment-errors').text(response.error.message);
              $form.find('button').prop('disabled', false);

              $form.find('button').replaceWith( '<button class="btn btn-lg letter-spacing-lg btn-insider-signup width-full padding-top-sm padding-bottom-sm margin-top-sm" type="submit">Make Payment</button>' );



          } else {

              // response contains id and card, which contains additional card details
              var token = response.id;

              //show a please wait message
              $form.find('.primary_message').show();
              $form.find('.payment-loading').replaceWith('<div class="alert alert-success text-center margin-top-sm" role="alert">Verifying Card Details.  Please wait.</div>');

              // Insert the token into the form so it gets submitted to the server
              $form.append($('<input type="hidden" name="stripeToken" />').val(token));
              // and submit

              $form.append($('<input type="hidden" name="stripeToken" />').val(token));


             $form.get(0).submit();

              
          }
      };

        var delay = (function(){
          var timer = 0;
          return function(callback, ms){
            clearTimeout (timer);
            timer = setTimeout(callback, ms);
          };
        })();


      $('#trial_plans').submit(function(event) {

          var $form = $('#trial_plans');

              // Disable the submit button to prevent repeated clicks
              $form.find('button').prop('disabled', true);

             Stripe.card.createToken($form, stripeResponseHandler);

              return false;
